expected_bands.label: Molecular oxygen
expected_bands.biosignature_relevance: Earth's dominant biosignature gas, but with well-documented abiotic production routes -- photolysis of water with hydrogen escape, and CO2 photolysis around M dwarfs. Not diagnostic in isolation.

expected_bands.label: Ozone
expected_bands.biosignature_relevance: A photochemical proxy for O2 detectable at lower abundance, inheriting every abiotic-oxygen ambiguity that O2 has.

expected_bands.label: Sodium
expected_bands.biosignature_relevance: Alkali resonance line; a classic hot-Jupiter atmospheric probe.
